research_question: For a fixed grounded 4B commitment classifier, how much do deterministic evidence selection and explicit cross-target relational context each improve pragmatic judgment, requested-action recall, and latency?

project_scope.system_component: supported VRM action pragmatic judgment after deterministic ontology grounding
project_scope.expected_project_effect: Improve human-like handling of coordinated requests, local negation, replacement, and cancellation without increasing model size or allowing free-form frame generation.

scientific_basis.name: value_agnostic_conversational_semantic_parsing
scientific_basis.design_use: Keep grounded values separate from the model's pragmatic relation judgment.

scientific_basis.name: symbolic_planning_and_code_generation_for_grounded_dialogue
scientific_basis.design_use: Represent all grounded targets explicitly before deterministic compilation.

scientific_basis.name: picard_constrained_decoding
scientific_basis.design_use: Reduce the generated contract to the one semantic field that cannot be selected deterministically.

ablation_conditions.v42_evidence_index_control: Frozen V42 Qwen3.5 4B result: target-only context with model-generated commitment and evidence_index.
ablation_conditions.commitment_only_candidate: Same target-only context and semantic definitions, but model outputs only commitment; evidence is selected deterministically.
ablation_conditions.relational_context_candidate: Same commitment-only contract plus all grounded targets and general cross-target pragmatic-scope guidance.

deterministic_evidence_selector.requested: Choose the latest target anchor not blocked by local negation or a later referential cancellation; if none exists, choose the latest anchor.
deterministic_evidence_selector.negated: Prefer the latest target anchor inside a locally negated clause; otherwise choose the latest anchor.
deterministic_evidence_selector.cancelled: Prefer the latest target anchor that occurs before a later referential cancellation; otherwise choose the latest anchor.
deterministic_evidence_selector.tie_breaker: For anchors with the same start position, choose the shortest span and then lexical pattern order.

relational_context.additional_input: all grounded domain-value targets and their exact anchor spans from the same utterance
general_rules: A state or manner syntactically coordinated with a direct imperative inherits the request force even if that target phrase is not itself an imperative verb.
Negation has local target and clause scope; do not transfer it to a different positively requested replacement or coordinated target.
A positive replacement after a negated target is judged independently from the earlier negation.
Cancelled means an earlier request for the same target is later withdrawn; negated means the target is prohibited or denied rather than withdrawn.
Mentioned is only discussion with no request force inherited from a linked imperative.

development_decision_rule: Only relational_context_candidate may advance. It must pass every development gate. The V42 control and commitment-only condition are causal ablations and cannot be selected.
decision_rule: A full development pass authorizes only creation and execution of a committed fresh holdout. A full fresh pass authorizes supported-action shadow integration; unsupported discovery and physical execution remain disabled.
